# 🎙️ Pipecat: Real-Time Voice & Multimodal AI Agents
## 🌐 Pipecat ecosystem
### 🤖 Claude Code skills
```
claude plugin marketplace add pipecat-ai/skills
```

## 🎬 See it in action
[![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat-examples/main/daily-multi-translation/image.png)](https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat-examples/tree/main/daily-multi-translation)[![](https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/raw/main/examples/assets/moondream.png)](https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/blob/main/examples/vision/vision-moondream.py)

## ⚡ Getting started
```
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
```

## 🛠️ Developing Pipecat
### Claude Code skills
```
claude plugin marketplace add pipecat-ai/pipecat
claude plugin install pipecat-dev@pipecat-dev-skills
```
